title_en: Promotion: 2026 AI Nationwide University Student Startup Hackathon at Hallym University
summary: University students nationwide who are interested may apply to the 2026 AI Nationwide University Student Startup Hackathon, hosted by the Hallym University Startup Support Headquarters; participation is voluntary. Applications are made through a Google Form reached by scanning the QR code on the event poster, from 27 October 2026 to 17:00 on 11 November 2026. The competition takes place on 19–20 November 2026 in the gymnasium on the 3rd floor of the Hallym University Recreation Center.
applies_to: University students nationwide who are interested in the competition. Participation is optional, not mandatory. Participants compete in teams of up to 4 people.

dates.what: Application period for the hackathon (closes at 17:00 on the last day)

conditions: The competition is limited to 100 participants in total (25 teams).
Each team may have a maximum of 4 members.
Entries must address the set topic: discover a startup idea using AI (edutech).
Applications are accepted only through the Google Form linked by the QR code on the event poster; the poster is an image that was not included in the notice text and was not read.
steps: Obtain the event poster (referred to in the original notice; its image was not read) and scan its QR code.
Complete and submit the Google Form application before 17:00 on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
Attend the competition on 19–20 November 2026 in the gymnasium on the 3rd floor of the Hallym University Recreation Center.
translation:
[Promotion] 2026 AI Nationwide University Student Startup Hackathon

The Hallym University Startup Support Headquarters is holding the "2026 AI Nationwide University Student Startup Hackathon" for university students nationwide, with the aim of generating innovative local startup ideas that combine creative perspectives with AI technology. Interested students are encouraged to participate.

◊ Event Overview

A. Competition dates / venue: Thursday 19 November 2026 to Friday 20 November 2026 / Gymnasium, 3rd floor, Hallym University Recreation Center
※ Applications: Tuesday 27 October 2026 to Wednesday 11 November 2026, 17:00

B. Number of participants: 100 in total (25 teams, maximum 4 people per team)

C. Topic: Discover a startup idea using AI (edutech)

D. Prizes: Total prize money of KRW 15,000,000

E. How to apply: Scan the QR code on the poster and apply via the Google Form.

[Note: The poster with the QR code is an image that was not included in the notice text and was not read.]
